title: LVV Certification Thresholds
content: LVV certification is required when a vehicle is modified to the extent that it is no longer within the manufacturer's original specifications. This includes modifications to the chassis, suspension, braking, or steering systems.

title: Scratch-built vs. Modified Production
content: A scratch-built vehicle is built from the ground up, while a modified production vehicle is a production vehicle that has been altered. Both may require LVV certification.

title: Three Groups of Modifications
content: Modifications are categorized into three groups: Group A (minor modifications), Group B (significant modifications), and Group C (major modifications). Group B and C modifications typically require LVV certification.
